dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Oh, please! No need to be so wary. All that come here are guests of the guild, and it's only fair that my duties involve helping them however I can.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Looking at you, though... Hmm, I'm guessing you're on the hunt for some legendary treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Well? Tell me about what you're looking for. You probably want some local help too, and hey, I've got lots of buddies in my back pocket who can lend a hand...
